fate_read.note: frames.py's 'decayed' is a destroyed event with no attacker; 18 of the 22 took enemy damage in the second they died (the record's dmg), the attackers out of our sight: corvroc 8 frames (1,173 metal; its rocket does 1,700 and four hits read 1,700-1,704), corwolv 2, corpun 2, corgol/cormart 2, corban 1, corsok 1, unidentified 2. True decays: 3 (the player's stop, 637 metal) and 1 after its builder was killed (armbeamer_19122, 30).

mechanisms: Fire from out of sight was never said for builders or frames, and every frame it killed was reported as abandoned ('its builder was sent elsewhere and the frame decayed'): 18 frames (1,627 metal) died with their builders on them, 8 to one corvroc in sight once in its eight minutes (armmex_7871, armllt_28157, armllt_13783, armllt_9995, armmex_10759, armpb_1106, armpb_12693, armpb_22119: 1,173 metal), the rest to corwolv, corpun, corgol, cormart, corban and corsok (armllt_24376, armllt_16133, armmex_12149, armllt_2772, armllt_26968, armmex_28804, armpb_4877, armmex_321, armmex_23205, armpb_1528: 454); a shelled-builder line or wake and a kill read from the frame's damage would have told the player from 23:10 that its D3/C4/C6 rebuilds stood in a rocket truck's reach (report; up to 1,627 metal, depending on its answer).

A builder's build was matched to any frame of its type within 200 of its site: in the packed advanced-solar field the entries of constructor_10629, constructor_11249 and constructor_20491 showed a neighbour's share ('98 % built', '78 % built') and turned to 'finishing an order' the second the neighbour finished (armadvsol_5903 at 10:31, armadvsol_27863 at 11:35), and the player, reading 'finishing an order; standing in the exit lane' as stuck, sent stop at 11:00 and 12:07 and dropped armadvsol_27075, armadvsol_5192 and armadvsol_29443 (637 metal); matching by the builder's own created frame would have kept all three (report/hands bookkeeping).

The home guard answered one corgator at the back field too late: the 19:25 packet gave back_field to group_Q1/group_T1 and told the commander to D-gun raiders at home, but the commander's attack_party_44 rated 0.21-0.26 and was never played and group_Q1 was sent 7 s after the corgator reached the fusion; armfus_10810 died at 30% (1,005 metal; with armllt_3117, 2, in the same raid) (hands-rule, medium).
unread: nothing torn or skipped; one seat, no symlink directory needed. frames.py reads a destroyed-by-nobody frame as decayed (18 of these 22 were kills from out of sight) and measures the never-started radius from the command's point, not the engine's placed site (21 of the 52 orders started after all).
